payout_quote: You may earn a $400 reward if you open a new Virtual Wallet with Performance Select or a $100 reward if you open new Virtual Wallet and meet all qualifying conditions... To receive the reward: 1) Open a new, eligible PNC checking product online via the application links on this page. 2) Set up and receive total qualifying direct deposit(s) within the first 60 days... The total amount of all qualifying direct deposits received into your Spend account must be at least $500 for Virtual Wallet or $5,000 for Virtual Wallet with Performance Select... Offer is valid 9/1/2026 through 1/7/2027. (Official PNC bonus offer page)
timing: Reward credited to the account within 60-90 days after all conditions are met
eligibility: New PNC consumer checking customers; no existing PNC consumer checking and none closed within the past 12 months; no PNC promotional premium received in the past 24 months; offer may vary by market
steps: Open a new PNC Virtual Wallet online via the bonus offer page
Set up direct deposit of paycheck, pension, Social Security or other regular income into the Spend account
Receive at least $500 in total qualifying direct deposits within the first 60 days
Keep the account open; the $100 reward credits within 60-90 days after conditions are met
catches: The $100 tier needs $500 in qualifying direct deposits within 60 days - cash advances, wire transfers, person-to-person transfers, account-to-account transfers, and branch/ATM/mobile deposits do NOT count
NOT eligible if you have any PNC consumer checking now, closed one in the past 12 months, or got a PNC promo in the past 24 months

The $100 tier uses the standard Virtual Wallet account, which carries a $7 monthly service charge - waived when you have a qualifying direct deposit (the same $500+ that earns the bonus waives it) or are under 25
The reward takes 60-90 days AFTER you qualify to arrive - this is a 4-5 month wait for $100
Offer varies by market and can be modified or discontinued at any time
biggest_catch: You wait 60 days to qualify and then another 60-90 days for the $100 to arrive - roughly 4-5 months total - and the Virtual Wallet account used for the $100 tier has a $7 monthly fee unless your qualifying direct deposit waives it.
